content.text: The insurance provisions fully match the preferred position.

input.quote: 18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18 places the insurance obligation squarely on Copperleaf (Vendor) and meets the preferred position on every material term: CGL of USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, professional E&O of USD 2M, cyber and privacy liability of USD 5M, and workers' compensation as required by law, maintained at Vendor's own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward. Section 18.2 adds certificates of insurance and evidence of coverage on request, reputable insurers, primacy over Customer's insurance where customary, notice of cancellation or material reduction, and confirms that insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities — all favourable to us. This exceeds the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) and includes employer's liability cover beyond the playbook ask, so no redline is warranted.
